newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse prices mixed, turnover slips.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse prices mixed, turnover slips.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse inched down on Tuesday amid thin interest due to the summer holiday, one broker said.
Average prices for 27 stocks went down and 20 rose. Another four listings had no trade and one was suspended.
Overall turnover fell to 10.72 billion lei from 12.3 billion previous.
Operators did not forecast major changes for Wednesday when they expected the market to slide further.

"Investors concentrated their interest for the third day in a row on the refrigerator maker Arctic," he said. He added that the stock had a good liquidity, which permitted trades in large blocks. Arctic closed 50 lei firmer at 3,650.
Pharmaceutical plants Terapia and Antibiotice ended 100 lei and 50 lei weaker to 9,300 and 7,450 respectively under selling pressure in late trading.
On the second tier, trade remained idle.
Three independent indices. the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, slid by 1.0, 1.025 and 0.99 percent respectively from Monday.
The VAB index is displayed on VANGUARD.
